post.description: Reason required; `notify` texts the client, including what happens to the deposit. The money held on the invoice is settled by the cancellation policy setting (GET /settings/cancellation-policy: refunded in full when the cancel is at least `freeCancelHours` ahead, otherwise `lateRetainBp` of it is kept) and written as ledger events: a system refund, exempt from the caller's refund limit, a card refund awaits Squarespace. `deposit` (default `policy`) overrides it: `keep`, or `refund_card` / `refund_credit` as the caller's own refund (needs pay.refund; over their limit it waits for approval). The invoice is canceled (a kept deposit stays on it: canceled_kept, a fully refunded one canceled_refunded). The response carries the `settlement`. Needs an Idempotency-Key.

The lines are priced again first (a covered line at the regular price, the others at the member price). Then one system adjust event (reason “Membership credit”) and one redeem per covered line, exempt from the caller’s adjust limit, attributed to the caller; `lines` lists them, `discountCents` is the total covered, `event` is the first adjust and `invoice` the invoice after the last. Refused: no live membership 404 `MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND`, not active 409 `MEMBERSHIP_NOT_ACTIVE`, already applied 409 `MEMBERSHIP_CREDIT_APPLIED`, nothing covered 409 `MEMBERSHIP_NOT_ELIGIBLE` / `MEMBERSHIP_NO_CREDIT`, no balance 409 `MEMBERSHIP_NO_BALANCE`, a reprice that would leave the invoice overpaid 409 `PRICE_CHANGE_OVERPAID`.

post.description: No session; Idempotency-Key required (replay answers the stored response). A new number creates the customer (the transactional kind of SMS consent when asked for); the number of a customer the shop already has links the booking to them and changes their record (name, email, consent, vehicle) only with a member token issued for that customer, otherwise what was typed goes on the appointment’s internal log. Books through the same command as the dashboard with the online rules, on the board’s grid, creates the invoice, queues the confirmation text and the usual ops events. Member and VIP privileges (no fee, VIP-held times, the VIP booking window) need a member token for the customer: without one the booking is a guest’s, owes the fee at the counter or by payment link (`deposit`), and `member`, `deposit` and `confirmationBy` (what was asked for) answer the same for every number. 409 PUBLIC_SLOT_TAKEN "That time was just taken. Pick another.", PUBLIC_SLOT_VIP, PUBLIC_SLOT_PAST, PUBLIC_SLOT_CLOSED, PUBLIC_SLOT_TOO_FAR; 409 IDENTITY_PIN_REQUIRED for a member token on a number whose client has a PIN (a PIN outranks a code); 401 PUBLIC_TOKEN_INVALID; 422 on validation (an impossible date, a start off the grid, a number the website does not text); 429 over 10 bookings an hour per address, 3 per number from one address or 5 per number. A non-empty `website` field (the honeypot) answers 202 with a fake reference and writes nothing.

post.description: No session; Idempotency-Key required. A new number: the customer, their vehicles and a membership in the pending state tied to the tier’s Squarespace product (when the product map has none the membership still waits and an alert is raised); staff get a notification asking them to text the checkout link; the person gets a welcome text saying so. The membership activates when the Squarespace sync sees the paid order. The number of a customer the shop already has, without a member token issued for that customer: the same 201, nothing written to the record and no text; staff get the request to confirm with the customer. With the token: the full path, and 409 PUBLIC_ALREADY_MEMBER for a live membership (held, or shared as a household member); 409 IDENTITY_PIN_REQUIRED when the number’s client has a PIN (a PIN outranks a code). 422 on validation; 429 over 10 an hour per address, 2 a day per number from one address or 3 a day per number.

post.description: No session. 202 with the challenge id whether or not the number is known or the text could go out (nothing about the number leaks). The code lives 10 minutes, allows 3 tries and replaces any earlier code for the number. 422 for a number that is not a US or Canadian mobile-capable number (another country, premium rate, toll free). Limits every 10 minutes: 10 per address, 3 per number from one address and 5 per number in all, charged in that order (a refused call charges nothing after the rule that refused it); 10 calls a minute per address (429 PUBLIC_RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After). At most PUBLIC_OTP_TEXTS_PER_HOUR codes are texted per rolling hour for every caller together: past it, 429 PUBLIC_CODES_PAUSED with Retry-After (the managers are told once an hour).

A code proves the number, not the client: on a record the stale-record rule holds (ADR 0160) `member` is empty (no name, not a member).

A name is resolved case-insensitively: exactly one match is added (201, toast "{name} is now VIP"); several matches, or only partial matches, answer 409 VIP_CLIENT_AMBIGUOUS with `meta.candidates` (id, name, last-four phone hint only with cli.contact, vehicles, alreadyVip) so the caller re-sends with a customerId; no match answers 404 VIP_CLIENT_NOT_FOUND. Adding someone who is already VIP answers 200 with `added: false`.
post.summary: Make a customer VIP, by customer id or by typed name

delete.summary: Remove a customer from the VIP list (no toast in the design)

post.description: A duplicate answers 409 VIP_HOLD_EXISTS with the design string "That slot is already held". `time` is "11:00 AM" or `timeMin` minutes; 5:00 AM to 11:30 PM in 30-minute steps.
post.summary: Reserve a weekly slot for VIPs

get.summary: Waitlist entries with their open offer

post.description: A canceled job on that date whose start falls in the window (and is long enough for the package) is offered to the entry by text. VIP clients are offered first when the VIP "Waitlist priority" toggle is on.
post.summary: Put a client on the waitlist for a date and a time window

post.description: The first accept wins: capacity is checked again, the slot is booked as an ordinary appointment and the other offers on it are withdrawn. 409 WAITLIST_NO_OFFER when there is no open offer or it has lapsed.

categories.description: The category keys the visit holds (package and live add-ons), in the categories’ order: the chips

category.description: The one word the visit counts under (KPIs, Payments split): its category ignoring add-ons, "mixed" for two or more, the add-ons category for add-ons alone, null for none

needsPriceConfirm.description: A line (the package or a live add-on) was charged a price the owner has not set for the size: the starting price (the size has no price of its own) or the service’s one price (no prices by size, not a quote): "Confirm price" until staff confirm the size

needsSizeConfirm.description: No size known: priced at the smallest size (the starting price) until staff confirm the size at the shop ("Confirm size")

vehicleClass.description: The vehicle size the visit is priced at (a size key); null when nobody knew it

coverage.description: What the membership covered: "Covered $40 · $20 size difference due"

differenceCents.description: line - covered: the size difference that stays due

planClassLabel.description: The size the membership is priced at

classLabel.description: The size the line is priced at

discountBp.description: The member % off applied, in basis points

listCents.description: The regular price at the size; null on a line priced before sizes

memberDiscountCents.description: list - price

vehicleClassLabel.description: The size the invoice is priced at ("Large SUV")

pricing.description: What the visit was priced at (ADR 0170)

basis.description: How a price was found: class (the size's own price), unknown_class (no size known: the smallest size's), estimated (the size has no price: the starting price), base (the service has no prices by size), legacy (priced before sizes)

confirmAtShop.description: A price depends on a size not known yet, or the size has no price of its own: the exact price is confirmed at the shop

member.description: Priced as a member (the holder or a household member of an active membership)

coveredCents.description: What the membership would cover (applied when the visit is completed)

dueCents.description: What the client owes before tax and tip

listCents.description: Sum of the regular prices at the size
